scope: Proposition 7.5 (Collar comparison) of the manuscript “The Kerr–Newman Penrose Inequality for Axisymmetric Electrovacuum Exteriors” (preprints/The-Kerr-Newman-Penrose-Inequality-for-Axisymmetric-Electrovacuum-Exteriors-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ff3098c8faf29685), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 46. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For all sufficiently large n and sufficiently large outer truncations, solutions in the first two homotopy stages satisfy, with constants c, C′ > 0 independent of n, R and the stage parameter, c τ0 ≤ ∂νf ≤ C′ τ0 (Bb), c τ0 ≤ −∂νf ≤ C′ τ0 (Bw). (7.35) They also satisfy b− ≤ h ≤ b+ on any fixed compact core needed in Equation (7.3). In the third stage one has |∂νf| ≤ C′/τ0. These conclusions need no upper bound for Z.
